articles.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra
articles.summary: OpenAI has launched Astra, a new model designed to handle longer-running work across browsers, spreadsheets, websites, and desktop applications. The release pushes AI further toward agents that can operate software rather than just generate responses.

articles.title: Snowflake's Latest Results Highlight Enterprise Demand for AI Model Alternatives Beyond Anthropic
articles.summary: Snowflake reported strong quarterly results driven in part by growth of its CoCo coding assistant. The growth reflects enterprise CIOs seeking cost savings after earlier AI spending surges and preference for tools accessing multiple models rather than lock-in to a single maker like Anthropic.

articles.title: Enterprises are looking beyond Nvidia for AI chips
articles.summary: Enterprise buyers are increasingly evaluating non-Nvidia accelerators as AI infrastructure costs and supply become bigger concerns. Alternative chips now appear more frequently than Nvidia's next-generation GPUs on enterprise evaluation lists.

articles.title: Three identity vendors shipped the same agent access pattern in eight days
articles.summary: Okta, Auth0, and Descope shipped Cross App Access implementations between August 24 and September 1, converging on Client ID Metadata Documents for client identity and ID-JAG token exchange for delegation. The two-layer pattern matters more than vendor order and will outlast any single network. B2B teams should therefore ensure their authorization servers speak the pattern rather than standardizing on a vendor first.

articles.title: Proofpoint launches an AI SOC Analyst Agent
articles.summary: Proofpoint introduced a SOC Analyst Agent powered by OpenAI's Daybreak models that turns natural-language security questions into structured investigations and recommended next steps. The product is currently in private preview.

articles.title: Cloudflare and OpenAI automate vulnerability remediation
articles.summary: Cloudflare is using OpenAI's Daybreak security models alongside production network signals to identify and prioritize vulnerabilities. The system can propose patches and validate fixes while keeping higher-risk actions under human control.

articles.title: Microsoft is ending Windows 11's web app slop era, and AI now writes native apps in 30 minutes
articles.summary: Microsoft has published a quick-start guide that the company says takes users from an empty folder to a published WinUI 3 app in about 30 minutes using VS Code, its winapp CLI, and the GitHub Copilot free tier. The workflow uses a specialized WinUI agent and includes AI-assisted migration guides for WPF and UWP apps to boost native apps in the Microsoft Store over web wrappers.

articles.title: Equinix wants the network to become AI's control plane
articles.summary: Equinix is positioning networking as a core layer for distributed enterprise AI inference, connecting models, compute, data, and clouds. Its new infrastructure aims to make deploying inference across providers easier to manage.

articles.title: Native IP functions for threat detection and hunting on Databricks
articles.summary: Databricks now offers built-in SQL IP functions in Public Preview for IPv4 and IPv6 subnet checks, CIDR arithmetic, parsing, and canonicalization. They simplify threat-hunting workflows like separating internal and external traffic and matching telemetry against threat-intel blocklists. Tests on a live Lakewatch workspace found they handle tricky IPv6 formats more reliably than regex or integer-based methods and outperform UDFs with Photon join optimizations.

articles.title: Tencent Opens WorkBuddy Platform to Third Parties in Enterprise AI Push
articles.summary: Tencent has launched an open platform for its workplace AI assistant WorkBuddy that makes its AI-agent capabilities available to third-party developers, hardware makers, and industry applications.

articles.title: Perplexity brings hybrid AI compute to Macs
articles.summary: Perplexity's new hybrid mode splits agent workloads between cloud models and local Mac models, keeping sensitive information on-device while using frontier models for heavier reasoning.
